content: A plane P contains the line of intersection of the plane $$\vec{r} \cdot(\hat{i}+\hat{j}+\hat{k})=6$$ and $$\vec{r} \cdot(2 \hat{i}+3 \hat{j}+4 \hat{k})=-5$$. If $$\mathrm{P}$$ passes through the point $$(0,2,-2)$$, then the square of distance of the point $$(12,12,18)$$ from the plane $$\mathrm{P}$$ is :
